description: Saved functional verification, not a current environment health check.
methods: Automated configuration; automated native Windows desktop sign-in, Command Prompt and File Explorer interaction.
Windows interactive-logon API type 2, then an impersonated real SMB file read; authorized file opened for write without modifying content.
limitations: Full conventional GUI configuration replay was not independently performed.
No retained GUI screenshots of account creation or permission-edit dialogs; the native command capture shows the resulting group and ACL.
No client restart or group removal/re-add exercise was performed.
Early client UTC timestamps differed from host timestamps; screenshot provenance uses host capture time. No Kerberos-only claim is made.
A controller restart was needed during verification; directory connectivity was re-established and functional checks passed afterward.
